name: Apprenticeship — Legacy Approved (Provider A), Different Provider Posts
description: Provider A's apprenticeship is a 'legacy' record: it is created directly by Commitments' ApprenticeshipCreatedEvent, never having existed as a draft (no prior SLD POST) — this is how every apprenticeship worked before FLP-1537 introduced the draft POST path, and is still how most existing ApprenticeshipLearning rows in production came to exist. Provider B then POSTs the same learner onto the same course (standard 21). Apprenticeships have no dedicated Change of Provider feature (unlike short courses), so this captures baseline behaviour: CreateDraftApprenticeshipLearningCommandHandler.Handle looks up the existing draft via GetAllByLearnerKey(learner.Key, ukprn, courseCode), scoped by UKPRN as well as course code — Provider B's UKPRN doesn't match Provider A's approved episode, so the lookup finds no match and a second, independent unapproved ApprenticeshipLearning row is created for Provider B rather than the POST being treated as an update to Provider A's approved row.

steps.name: Commitments Approves an Apprenticeship (Provider A, Never a Draft)
SLD (Provider B) Creates a Draft Apprenticeship for the Same Learner and Course

assertions.name: Two separate ApprenticeshipLearning rows exist for the learner, one per provider
Provider A's episode remains approved, Provider B's is an unapproved draft
